papers.title_en: Distributed Convolutional Rank Regression over Decentralized Networks
papers.authors: Chunjing Li, Tiange Zhao, Xiaohui Yuan
papers.evidence: 去中心化分布式学习框架，具有高通信效率
papers.tldr: 针对去中心化网络中的分布式学习，本文提出了一种卷积秩回归框架。该方法利用核平滑秩损失和共识约束优化，仅依赖本地数据和邻居信息交换，实现了隐私保护和高效通信。在异质网络下，推导了有限样本误差界，并证明了稀疏LASSO估计量的精确支持恢复。采用广义共识ADMM求解，仿真和真实数据实验验证了其优越性能。
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies convolution rank regression (CRR) over decentralized distributed learning networks. We propose a novel decentralized CRR framework, in which estimators are obtained by solving consensus-constrained optimization with kernel-smoothed rank loss. The developed estimation scheme relies solely on local node data and information shared by neighboring nodes, thereby achieving privacy preservation and high communication efficiency. For heterogeneous network settings, we establish finite-sample error bounds for the decentralized CRR estimator and derive exact support recovery guarantees for the sparse decentralized CRR LASSO estimator. To facilitate numerical implementation, we adopt a generalized consensus ADMM to efficiently solve local subproblems across all network nodes. We verify the favorable performance of our developed approach via extensive numerical simulations and real-data experiments.

papers.title_en: Remedying Coarsening-Based GNN Training under Heterophily via Adaptive Complementary Enhancement
papers.authors: Guoming Li, Jian Yang, Xukun Wang, Zixiao Wang, Shangsong Liang, Yifan Chen
papers.evidence: 基于粗化的GNN训练方法用于大规模图缩放
papers.tldr: 粗化训练通过在小规模粗化图上训练图神经网络来加速大规模图处理，但在异配图（heterophilic graphs）上性能严重下降，原因是粗化过程丢失了关键图信息。为此，提出自适应互补增强（ACE）策略，它学习一个投影器从粗化节点特征重构原始节点特征，并引入各向异性结构正则化来捕获局部异配模式。同时采用同方差不确定性加权自动平衡粗化图主损失与全图辅助损失的组合。在多种异配基准上，ACE在保持同配图竞争力的情况下持续提升准确率，且额外计算开销极小。该工作为异配场景下粗化训练提供了有效补救方案。
papers.abstract_en: Coarsening-based training for graph neural networks (GNNs), i.e.\ training on coarsened graphs rather than the original large ones, has become a promising direction for scaling GNNs to massive graphs. However, prior work has been evaluated almost exclusively on \textit{homophilic} graphs, leaving the more challenging \textit{heterophilic} settings underexplored. We show, both empirically and theoretically, that existing coarsening-based training methods suffer significant performance degradation on heterophilic graphs due to inevitable loss of graph information during coarsening. To address this, we propose {\bf A}daptive {\bf C}omplementary {\bf E}nhancement, a plug-and-play, model-agnostic strategy that reintegrates the information discarded in coarsening: ACE learns a projector for re-constructing original node features and applies \textit{anisotropic structural regularization} to embed local heterophily. We further adopt \textit{homoscedastic uncertainty weighting} to adaptively balance the combined training objective of primary coarsened-graph training loss and full-graph auxiliary loss with augmented node features re-constructed by the heterophily-aware projector. Extensive experiments show that ACE drives consistent gains on heterophilic benchmarks while preserving competitive results on homophilic graphs with minimal computational overhead. Code is available at the GitHub repository: https://github.com/vasile-paskardlgm/ACE.
